fields.criteria_text: First-time freshmen may declare nursing with a high school GPA of 3.5 or higher (or GED 660 / HiSET 75), a B or better in high school biology and college-level placement; those who meet all three semester milestones are admitted into the nursing program in their fourth semester. Others apply through academic candidacy.
paths: first-time freshman candidacy (milestones, admitted in the fourth semester)
